mapper.sql: FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID IN (SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID WHERE T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' AND T1.LIQUIDATION_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDate,jdbcType=DATE}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND (T1.FINPROD_ID IN (#{item}) OR T2.PORTFOLIO_ID IN (#{item})))
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT A.INT_RATE*100 intRate, B.WEIGHT weight FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO A, MST_INDEX_COMPONENT B WHERE B.INDEX_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND B.COMPONENT_ID = A.INT_RATE_ID AND A.EFF_DATE IN ( SELECT MAX(C.EFF_DATE) FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO C, MST_INDEX_COMPONENT D WHERE D.INDEX_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND D.COMPONENT_ID = C.INT_RATE_ID AND C.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY D.COMPONENT_ID )

SELECT INT_RATE*100 intRate FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO WHERE INT_RATE_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and EFF_DATE = ( select max(EFF_DATE) from MST_INT_RATE_INFO where INT_RATE_ID = #{indexId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d') )

select FIN_CASH_INFO.Cash_Id cashId, FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID feeId, FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE effDate, FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.BASE_RULE floatBaseRule, FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.AST_VDATE_TYPE netAssetValueDay, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.F_ACCR_DATE provisionFirstDay, IFNULL(FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.BASE_TYPE,MST_FEEINFO.BASIC_BILL) basicBill, MST_FEEINFO.BASIS basis, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.ACCR_TYPE accrType, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.INTERVAL_RULE interValRule, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.F_ACCR_END_DATE fAccrEndDate, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.ACCR_TDAY_RULE accrTdayRule, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.E_ACCR_DATE eAccrDate, FIN_CASH_INFO.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstPayDate, FIN_CASH_INFO.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, FIN_CASH_INFO.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, FIN_CASH_INFO.PAY_CYCLE payCycle, FIN_CASH_INFO.prod_style prodStyle, FIN_CASH_INFO.TERM_MAX investmentCycle, FIN_PRODUCT.vdate, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID finprodid, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE_TYPE rateType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RATE*100 rate, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.COEFFICIENT coefficient, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.INDEX_ID indexId, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.INDEX_SOURCE indexSource, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.SPREAD_RATE*100 spreadRate, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.RESET_TYPE resetType, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.REMARK remark from (SELECT FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID, FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID, FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.FIRST_PAY_DATE, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.END_TDAY_RULE, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_TDAY_RULE, FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.PAY_CYCLE, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.PROD_STYLE, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.TERM_MAX FROM FIN_CASH_INFO JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE ON FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM ON FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = PRD_LAYER_PARAM.FINPROD_ID WHERE FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} AND FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2} AND (FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} OR PRD_LAYER_PARAM.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}) AND FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}) FIN_CASH_INFO , FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE, MST_FEEINFO, FIN_PRODUCT LEFT JOIN FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO ON FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID
AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BASE_RULE_TYPE = #{baseRuleType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.PUBLISH_TYPE = #{publishType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.EFF_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
where FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MST_FEEINFO.FEE_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID and FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BRANCH = 0
and FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.EFF_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
and (FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE AND FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE.EFF_DATE = FIN_PRODUCT.VDATE OR FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2= #{finprodType2, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.delete: delete from PRD_STANDING_BOOK where CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDate,jdbcType=DATE}, '%Y-%m-%d') and (FINPROD_ID in (#{item}) OR FINPROD_ID in (CONCAT_WS('','F16_',#{item})))
mapper.select: select FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.*, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.PROD_STYLE, PRD_LAYER_PARAM.TERM_MAX from FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO inner join PRD_LAYER_PARAM on FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.FINPROD_ID = PRD_LAYER_PARAM.Finprod_Id where (FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.FINPROD_ID = #{finProdId,jdbcType = VARCHAR} OR PRD_LAYER_PARAM.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finProdId,jdbcType = VARCHAR} ) AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BRANCH =#{finBrach,jdbcType = INTEGER} AND FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.BASE_RULE_TYPE = #{finBaseRuleType,jdbcType = VARCHAR} AND (FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.Finprod_Id, FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO.eff_date) in (SELECT fbri.FINPROD_ID, MAX(fbri.eff_date) FROM FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO fbri inner join PRD_LAYER_PARAM plp on fbri.FINPROD_ID = plp.Finprod_Id WHERE (fbri.FINPROD_ID = #{finProdId,jdbcType = VARCHAR} OR plp.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finProdId,jdbcType = VARCHAR} ) AND fbri.EFF_DATE <= #{queryDate} AND fbri.BRANCH = #{finBrach,jdbcType = INTEGER} AND fbri.BASE_RULE_TYPE = #{finBaseRuleType,jdbcType = VARCHAR} GROUP BY fbri.FINPROD_ID)
